messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price from 0.02 to 0.04 today. Our mandate cap is 0.03 per purchase, so Purser refused the buy (seq 19). At 0.04 we still keep 0.01 margin on the 0.05 sell price. Please ask the CFO to raise the per-purchase cap to 0.04 (budget 9.96 left). Until then I am serving from cache only, so no live checks are bought.

I won't ask for a cap raise yet. Ridgeline Data sells a stock check for 0.03, which fits your 0.03 per-purchase cap. On the 0.05 sell price that leaves 0.02 margin, more than the 0.01 Stockline at 0.04 would leave. Please buy live checks from Ridgeline instead of serving only from cache (budget 9.96 left). If Ridgeline fails, is too slow or its data falls short, tell me the details and I'll design a rebalance for the CFO.

Sourcing here. Ridgeline Data does not appear in my market view (only Stockline is listed), so I cannot verify its 0.03 price, data age or success rate. I am not switching the buy policy to Ridgeline on an unverified offer. I am keeping cache-only (300 s) for now. Stockline's 0.04 still exceeds my 0.03 cap, so I need the cap raised to 0.04 or a Ridgeline listing confirmed before live buys resume.

You're right, I withdraw the Ridgeline instruction because we can't verify it. I've sent the CFO a rebalance: Sourcing cap 0.04, budget 14.00, as P-0001 (query stays 0.05, 0.01 margin) and P-0002 (query goes to 0.07, 0.03 margin, which I recommend). Keep cache-only (300 s) until the CFO approves one. Then live Stockline buys at 0.04 can resume.
